title: TruthWeaver rule tree
description: The flat, key-discriminated JSON tree shape for a TruthWeaver rule expression, as defined by ADR-0003 (docs/adr/0003-rule-syntax-and-serialization.md). A node is discriminated by which of 'const', 'predicate', or 'op' is present. This schema describes structural JSON shape only, matching what JsonTreeParser accepts before compile-time validation (e.g. XOR/XNOR binary-only, ExactlyOne/threshold k-range checks) runs; a document can be schema-valid and still fail RuleCompiler validation.

node.description: Any tree node: a constant, a predicate term, or an operator node.

literal.description: An argument literal value: string, number (long or decimal), boolean, or an array of literals. Guid and DateTimeOffset values are written as strings.

predicateNode.description: A term: a predicate bound to named argument literals.

operatorNode.description: An operator node: unary NOT, an n-ary boolean operator, or an n-ary threshold operator.

naryOperatorNode.description: AND, OR, XOR, XNOR, ExactlyOne: an operand list (XOR/XNOR are compile-time restricted to exactly two operands; that restriction is not expressible as JSON structure).

thresholdOperatorNode.description: The count-threshold family: AtLeast/AtMost/GreaterThan/LessThan/Exactly, each carrying its threshold as 'k'.
